notes.title: Party Maker available now !
notes.content:
The full version of Party Maker has just become available on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36658449/cff8464474706eefcca77848957356755a0ba4ca.jpg[/img]

Don’t hesitate and check out our game! We’ve prepared for you over a dozen fascinating locations, hundreds of decorations and many more!

It’s just one click away from you. Just hit the download button and start your own Event Agency!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Trainer gestures
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38371058/c6c110f5c4f7d7269cffd6df6115b74d67f41dda.jpg[/img]
[h2]Our dolphin begins to respond to standard training. ![/h2]

We have added gesture initiation. Gestures consist of movements after which the Dolphin begins to execute our commands. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/P1PsKHy/1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tBr0PFs/2.gif[/img]

[b]The gestures will consist of the movements of the controller in the air imitating acrobatics to be performed by the dolphin. [/b]

It's getting interesting! Stay tuned, next DOLPHIN TRAINER VR development updates are coming soon!

[url=https://discord.gg/RFCG8Vff2U][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38371058/9fd10616552289cdae7d10c1a76cdf73b678b1d8.jpg[/img][/url]
